text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's—after wrapping up my light 
first duties, I took a breather. From the 
hallway, I could hear Umamusume exchanging 
New Year's greetings.
choice_data_list: (I wonder how Hishi Miracle is doing.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I have a hunch what it's about, but 
still. Thinking that, I cleared off my 
desk and decided to head out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer? Oh, what a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bumped into Hishi Miracle at the 
shopping street. I exchanged New Year's 
greetings, but since I never expected to 
run into her, I blurted it out without 
thinking.
choice_data_list:
I thought you'd be lounging around at 
home...

I thought you'd be lounging around at 
home...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so mean! You're making me sound like a 
total slacker fiend!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna laze around forever~. The me 
of this year is completely different, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Look, I felt like moving around, so I went 
out for a walk on my own. Pretty 
impressive, huh?
choice_data_list: Then why don't you get some more exercise?
Then why don't you get some more exercise?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is that... perhaps some kind of training—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no way, no way in hell~! It's New 
Year's, you know? It's bright red on the 
calendar! A holiday among holidays!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You should make the most of your precious 
vacation. Today is your day off too, 
Trainer! Right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... She backed off quite easily.
choice_data_list: Because you worked so hard last year.
Because you worked so hard last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once her debut was locked in, Hishi 
Miracle diligently trained day in and day 
out. In her own way, she really kept at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
………… Ehehe... hearing you say that makes 
me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking back, I really feel like I 
worked hard last year. Compared to before 
my debut, I've genuinely put in the 
effort.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me, I can do it when I try." 
...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So this year... I think I'll do my best. 
Well, at my own pace, of course.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that starts after our break. 
Today, we play!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, what kind of things 
do you do for fun? I'm kind of curious~.
choice_data_list:
Conquering every ride at the amusement 
park
Spending some relaxing time at the cafe
Test your luck with a lucky bag!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, so we're going all out to have 
maximum fun! Sounds great~ I want to play 
with everything I've got too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I went to the amusement park with 
Hishi Miracle. Upon arriving at the 
entrance, we ran into two people we knew 
very well.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mirako, Happy New Marvelous☆★☆ What an 
incredible coincidence! Statistically 
super, ultra rare! Let's give thanks for 
this marvelous twist of fate★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! I'm so happy somehow! Hey, hey, 
wanna check out the attractions together?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea! Trainer, with the two of 
you, I bet you know the best way to get 
around the attractions efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
In that case, leave it to Maya and the 
crew! I'll guide you through a route where 
we can easily ride everything!
choice_data_list: I'll definitely be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! MAAARVELOOOUUUS☆ Roller coaster 
going zoom-zoom-zooom★

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Hyaaaaaah! ...Aha, hahaha~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Maya figured it out! I solved the 
escape puzzle! Everyone, this way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I finally caught— wait, you're running 
again?! Wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay yay, conquered all the attractionsâ 
Marvelousâ â Next, let's conquer the 
souvenir shops!
choice_data_list: Those two are always so full of energy...
Those two are always so full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So this is the rumored "Boot 
Camp"... It's fifty times harder than I 
imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle unintentionally 
ended up having a rather grueling New 
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I love relaxing at a cafe too~. Shall we 
head over right now?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I entered a cozy cafe with Hishi Miracle. 
Then, a familiar face came over to serve 
us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Oh, Hishi Miracle. Happy New 
Year!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ryan-chan? You surprised me. A 
part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
An acquaintance runs this place. They 
helped me out a ton before, so I'm helping 
out as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fueh~, well look at that. Thanks for all 
your hard work right from New Year's~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm having a blast doing it! Well, 
call me over once you've decided on your 
order.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you hear? She's helping out, 
completely free of charge. It's just so 
like Ryan-chan, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Spending your precious day off like 
that... I could never do it. Seriously, 
you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Ryan-san! Could you shake my hand, 
please!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure! —Now then, may I take 
your hand?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're really going all out, even with fan 
service. I mean, you look so used to 
dealing with fans~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We really live in different worlds, don't 
we? Ah~, this caffe latte is so good~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though impressed by Mejiro Ryan's 
diligence, Hishi Miracle continued to 
relax without a care in the world.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A lucky bag! I wanna see what's inside~. 
Trainer, can I come along with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, the one standing in front of the 
lucky bag cart... Isn't that 
Nakayama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the crowd at the special venue, 
Nakayama Festa could be seen in the front 
row, scrutinizing the lucky bags.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It certainly promises more items than the 
price tag suggests... However, the 
question is whether I can actually use 
them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I misread the situation and 
drew the short straw. —This year, I'll see 
right through it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we're aiming for the high-price 
tier! High risk, high return is the true 
thrill of a gamble!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The bag's size, color, placement... The 
bet derived from all this is—THIS ONE!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...That's, kind of amazing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed you can take a chance on 
expensive lucky bags. I've struck out with 
them before, so I'm too scared to buy 
expensive ones.
choice_data_list: Aren't you buying any more lucky bags?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I just don't take reckless gambles. I 
do buy the popular lucky bags every year 
since they're guaranteed to be a good 
deal~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If we're here, I'd recommend the import 
grocery lucky bags. Care to try one?
choice_data_list: Yeah, maybe I'll buy that one too.
Yeah, maybe I'll buy that one too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, how about we try some safe, 
sound, and foolproof luck testing~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I can help it, I'd rather not fail. And 
so, I went with Hishi Miracle to test our 
luck on a grab bag that was guaranteed a 
win.
